name: PRs
description: Shows your pull requests and the reviews requested from you, grouped by what to do next. Reads GitHub through the gh command.

settings.title: Repositories to show
settings.description: Owners or repositories, separated by spaces, commas or new lines (for example: acme, acme/api). Leave empty to show all. A name that does not exist matches nothing.

settings.title: Path to the gh command
settings.description: Leave empty to find gh on PATH. If it is not found, enter the full path (for example /opt/homebrew/bin/gh).
